punkte.text: Share a lesson with your partner. You only see each other's answers to the reflection question once both of you have answered.
Different levels of desire, life phases, and pain, shame and performance pressure. Plus deepening lessons in five courses.
Even when the app is closed, you learn about new messages in the couple channel. The notice reveals no content.
Lessons call your partner by name once you enter name and gender in the couple channel.
10 to 30 minutes just for you: a voice guides you through breathing and a journey across your body, as close as you like. Found in course 18.

punkte.titel: New course: The anatomy of arousal
punkte.text: There are more erogenous zones than penis, breasts and clitoris. With an exercise for your own map of pleasure.
Course 18 has become warmer and more precise, and has been re-recorded.
Couple lessons are now read by Victoria and Martin in turns.
From now on you'll see this screen once after every update.
Below every audio you can report when the voice stresses a word wrongly. The report goes to GitHub, where it is public and needs an account. In discreet mode the link is hidden.
Shared answers from the yes/no list now arrive in full, even if your partner was offline. And when connecting, the app fetches everything since last time.
Below your last message it says “Read” as soon as your partner has seen it – if you both have a current version. You can switch it off in the couple channel's menu; then neither of you sees it.
In the couple channel's menu you can disconnect. If you connect with someone else, the old history is deleted – after asking you first.
The yes/no list is now included in the backup, and when restoring, check-ins and answers are merged instead of overwritten.
10 to 30 minutes just for you: a voice guides you through breathing and a journey across your body, as close as you like. Found in course 18.
Different levels of desire, life phases, pain, shame and performance pressure, and the anatomy of arousal. Plus deepening lessons and a rewritten course 18.
Share a lesson with your partner. You only see each other's answers to the reflection question once both of you have answered.
Notice of new messages even when the app is closed, read receipts, “Disconnect” in the menu – and shared yes/no answers now arrive in full.
Lessons call your partner by name once you enter name and gender in the couple channel.
Couple lessons are read by Victoria and Martin in turns. If a word sounds wrong, you can report it below every audio.
If you were in the beta test, the update channel is now back on stable. For the next test round you can sign up again in your profile under “Receive beta versions”. Thanks for testing!
On English phones the app now appears in English – interface, courses and exercises. You can switch the language in your profile. English recordings come as a pack to download.
The yes/no/maybe list now also asks about watching porn together and about visiting a swingers' club just the two of you, where others may at most watch.
The lessons on erection problems, pain during sex and the anatomy of arousal are worded more carefully: what is established, what is a hypothesis, and when it makes sense to see a doctor.
The shared evening and the self-exploration have labelled buttons to pause, skip and stop. Before the self-exploration, a short note says that nothing has to happen.
The couple channel now explains more precisely what the servers can see: not the content, but when and how often you write.
Updates are only installed with a valid checksum from this project, and damaged backups are rejected with a clear message.
18+ and only if you turn it on in your profile: the levels “Spicy” and “Extra spicy” for the body journey and the shared evening, two new courses and more yes/maybe/no questions.
Martin now reads all German texts a little more slowly, so the body journey and lessons sound more relaxed.
Under Profile › Language you can now download the recordings for the new content.
Everything from the test versions is now available to everyone: English, spicy mode, a calmer voice for Martin and many small improvements.
If you tested beta versions, you're now back on the stable channel. For the next test round, switch “Receive beta versions” in your profile back on.

punkte.titel: Guided audio right on the start page
punkte.text: You'll now find the body journey and the shared evening at the top of the courses and in the couple channel, with new images.

punkte.titel: New course: Every body is beautiful and sexy
punkte.text: Five lessons against comparison: the variety of real bodies, a kind look in the mirror, lights on in bed, and kindness when your body changes.
In spicy mode the app now glows red, and in the couple chat you can invite your partner to spicy mode.
“Every body is beautiful and sexy” has been rewritten: longer, for women and men, covering the whole body from skin and hair to belly, chest and build.
How desire stays alive between coffee and calendar: small gestures, anticipation, rituals and games.
In spicy mode: wilder texts, dedicated sections for the breasts, spicy lessons in eight courses, hot sparks, messages that disappear after reading, and photos straight from phone to phone.
The question mark at the top explains every part of the app.
New lessons in courses 25 and 26: lingerie for every body, lingerie in everyday life and a striptease to try. In Spicy mode also: Wrapped up hot.
The English audio pack is up to date. If you've already downloaded it, you can update it in your profile.
Photos in the couple chat are marked as experimental: on some mobile networks the direct connection doesn't work yet. Before viewing, the app asks whether you're alone.
Whoever shows their code now gets the request right in the pairing window and can confirm it. Before, the scanned side never noticed.

Everything from the recent betas is now in the stable version: course 26 Everyday eroticism, lessons on lingerie and striptease, the guide, a hotter spicy mode with photos and disappearing messages, and the fixed pairing by QR code.

You can now send wishes, bugs and mispronounced words straight from the app: anonymous and encrypted, no account needed. Find it in your profile and in the guide, and for pronunciation right below every player.

Course 25 shows what is out there, what to look for in material, care and safety, how to talk about it together and (in spicy mode) how to start alone and as a couple. With German recordings; English recordings follow with a later audio package.
The courses are now sorted by topic and renumbered: Foundations, Body and self, Relationship and everyday life, Touch and practice, Fantasy and play. Your progress is kept.

A long, quiet companion into sleep, 60, 90 or 120 minutes. You choose a focus or let yourself be surprised. The voice grows quieter and rarer, and in the end a soft sound remains. Find it with the guided audios on the start page. German recordings now, the English ones follow with a later audio package.

A waiting photo now also arrives when you're both online again after being offline. The app keeps trying on its own, and “Try again now” tries right away. If the sender no longer has a photo, the app now says so clearly.

Messages now travel sealed (NIP-17) as soon as your partner's phone has this version too: the relays can no longer see who writes to whom and when, and the length gives away less. This sets itself up after the first message. With an older version you keep writing as before.

Victoria's and Martin's voices are no longer inside the app itself but come as packs: lessons and guided audio, in German and English. The app gets much smaller, and corrected recordings arrive without an update. Download them once in your profile under “Recordings”, ideally on Wi-Fi.

A new guided audio for the night: you choose a dream image, the voice accompanies you into sleep and gives you a gentle dream intention. 30 to 60 minutes, on the home screen with the guided audios. The recordings come with the guided audio pack.
